$comment: Every external source the teaching surfaces cite. Each entry carries the date it was last read, because a link that rotted is a citation nobody can check. tests/sources.test.ts binds this list to the pages in both directions: a URL on a page that is not here fails, and an entry here that no page cites fails. Reachability is a separate CI job, because a gate that needs the network cannot live in make check.

sources.title: Balancing AI tensions: moving from AI adoption to effective SDLC use
sources.publisher: DORA, from the 2025 State of AI-assisted Software Development report
sources.supports: Adoption at 90 percent of technology professionals, a third of developers reporting little or no trust in AI-generated code, adoption correlating with higher throughput and higher instability at the same time, and the amplifier finding

sources.title: Measuring the impact of early-2025 AI on experienced open-source developer productivity
sources.supports: The randomised trial in which sixteen experienced developers took 19 percent longer on 246 real tasks with AI tools, while believing they had been faster

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications
sources.publisher: OWASP GenAI Security Project, published 9 December 2025
sources.supports: The named agentic risk classes each layer of the factory removes, from goal hijack through to rogue agents

sources.title: Effective context engineering for AI agents
sources.supports: Compaction, structured note-taking and sub-agent architectures as the published alternatives to a prompt that keeps growing
